admission.justification: One test pins byte-identical output for two merges of the same three trees, so a future merge change that reads a clock or iterates unordered state fails before it lands.

applicability: Every structural merge of three converted trees.
conditions: The merge reads the three input trees only, with canonical ordering and deterministic allocation.

evidence: Rationale: merge_trees is a pure function of the three input trees (no clock, no randomness; canonical ordering and deterministic allocation), so the same inputs give identical bytes. Observed: test_the_same_three_trees_merge_to_identical_bytes merges twice and compares every file and conflict identity.

statement: Determinism: the same three trees merged twice give identical bytes
